title: sdks: unify auth/retries and streaming ergonomics across python/typescript/go (parity + v1.50.0 bumps)
author: Ava Chen
description:
Unify SDK behaviors for auth/retries and streaming ergonomics across Python, TypeScript, and Go. This PR addresses several long-standing parity gaps and prepares the SDKs for a coordinated v1.50.0 release. Motivation: customers expect consistent retry semantics and streaming ergonomics across languages; our previous drift caused confusion and subtle production bugs (missing auth refresh on streaming reconnects, inconsistent backoff defaults, and different streaming iterator ergonomics). Changes include a shared auth+retry strategy, streaming client API harmonization, small ergonomic surface improvements, and per-SDK version bumps.

Checklist:
- [x] Implement shared retry/auth strategy (token refresh, jittered exponential backoff, idempotency hints)
- [x] Bring streaming API ergonomics in line (sync/async iterators, consistent cancel semantics, reconnect hooks)
- [x] Parity fixes for edge cases discovered in integration tests
- [x] Add cross-language conformance tests and update CI matrix
- [x] Bump SDK versions to v1.50.0
- [x] Update release notes and changelogs

High-level summary of changes (commits trimmed for readability):
- feat(sdk-common): introduce AuthRetryPolicy and shared token refresher hooks
- feat(python): SDK: adopt AuthRetryPolicy, add AsyncStreamScanner, update examples
- feat(ts): SDK: unify streaming iterator API, add reconnect handler and retry-metadata
- feat(go): SDK: align client.Stream API, add backoff util and token refresher integration
- test: add cross-language streaming conformance suite and flaky-case reproductions
- docs: update migration guide and changelogs

Notes: This is a coordinated release across three repositories bundled in a single monorepo PR. Where language-specific constraints required minor API differences, adapters were added and documented. See release_notes field for the user-facing summary.

release_notes:
- SDKs (Python/TS/Go): unify auth token refresh and retry semantics to reduce production reconnect failures.
- Streaming APIs: harmonized iterator ergonomics and added reconnect hooks and cancel semantics.
- Added cross-language conformance tests for streaming edge cases.
- Bumped all SDK versions to v1.50.0 and updated documentation.
Migration: See sdks/*/CHANGELOG.md for per-language migration steps.
migration_steps: Python: replace old StreamingClient.stream_iter with StreamingClient.stream (backwards-compatible adapter provided)
TypeScript: small rename stream.nextChunk() -> stream.next(); adapter preserved for one release
Go: Stream.Next now returns (Chunk, error) and supports context cancellation; adapters added
notes: CI initially failed on flaky conformance test; reran the matrix and fixed a race by serializing token refresh in the runtime. Coordinated release required tagging and publishing each SDK package after merge. Monorepo release tooling handled version bump commits.
